title: Assertion
source_docs: HDL Verifier/For Use with DPI-C SystemVerilog/Assertion.md
text: Generate SystemVerilog assertions from Simulink assertion, 1 input, {Severity} sets Severity of assertion failure; {Enable assertion} enables or disable assertion, {Simulation callback when assertion fails} sets the expression to evaluate when assertion fails MATLAB, {Stop simulation when assertion fails} sets the stop Simulink simulation when assertion, {Assertion fail message} sets the custom message when assertion fails no and {Assertion custom command} sets the custom command to execute when assertion fails SystemVerilog. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Port_1
ports.summary: Signal to check for nonzero value scalar | vector | matrix

params.name: Enable assertion
params.values: Enable or disable assertion on (default) | off

params.name: Simulation callback when assertion fails
params.values: Expression to evaluate when assertion fails MATLAB expression

params.name: Stop simulation when assertion fails
params.values: Stop Simulink simulation when assertion fails off (default) | on

params.name: Severity
params.values: Severity of assertion failure error (default) | warning | custom

params.name: Assertion fail message
params.values: Custom message when assertion fails no default

params.name: Assertion custom command
params.values: Custom command to execute when assertion fails SystemVerilog command
